summary: Tested Questions & FAQ admin tab, open-question visibility/answered scope, owner-only share toggle, FAQ CRUD, member FAQ tab, and club team badge migration key. Backend: 16/17 pytest pass. The one failure: a follow-up reply from the asker does NOT re-open an answered question (answered_at is never cleared). Frontend: all requested flows work for owner, non-owner Full, Content-level staff and member (desktop + mobile).

critical.issue: Asker follow-up doesn't re-open the question. members_team_reply (server.py ~line 13552) only does $push replies + $set updated_at. It never $unset answered_at/answered_by, so the question stays 'Answered' and drops off the Open list. Repro: staff marks Q answered, member replies, then GET /api/admin/team-questions still shows answered_at set.

integration_issues.issue: share() in OpenQuestions.jsx has no try/catch, so a failed PUT gives an unhandled rejection with no toast. Cosmetic since only owners see it.

issues: Tab grid leaves 'My Profile' alone, centered on its own last row. Pre-existing layout, minor.

action_items: In members_team_reply: when the replier is the asker (q['from']['user_id'] == uid), add '$unset': {'answered_at': '', 'answered_by': ''} to the update so the question re-opens. Optional: also re-open on email-inbound replies, if that path writes to team_questions.
Optional: wrap OpenQuestions share() in try/catch and show a toast.
critical_code_review_comments: FAQ order = count_documents at insert time. After deletes, orders can repeat; created_at tiebreak keeps it stable. No reorder UI, which is fine.
DELETE /api/admin/faq/{id} returns 200 even for unknown ids. Acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Temp example.com users qa64_* plus sessions (including a temp session qa64_owner_tok for vincekudjoe's user_id), 2 team_questions and TEST_QA64 faqs. All removed via qa_iter64_setup.py down. The settings team_questions.all_staff was toggled during the test and reset to false (the key now exists with all_staff=false; before the test it did not exist).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: python3 tests/qa_iter64_setup.py up; pytest tests/test_iter64_questions_faq.py -n 0; then qa_iter64_setup.py down (the down step must run after each pytest run because the fixture creates questions). Migration key migrate:club_team_badges_2026_06 exists and both owner admins have club_team_badge=true. Not re-run. Verified in UI: owner sees toggle + all questions; non-owner/content see only own unless all_staff; Add to FAQ prefills question + recipient's last reply; Hidden tag; validation toast; edit/delete with confirm; member FAQ accordion shows only published entries, no sister name, and the empty state works.
rca of the issue: members_team_reply's update_one lacks the $unset of answered_at/answered_by. The feature spec says an asker follow-up should clear answered_at. Fix: build the update dict, and if uid == q['from']['user_id'], add $unset.
